Monster-heavy substitution
Against a monster-heavy opponent, retain regular Slayers or substitute Giant Slayers for the two Doomseekers. That is a change of job, not an automatic upgrade ladder.
Optional allied-relief flavour

For an optional allied-relief flavour, an outpost-provided Empire infantry or gunpowder detachment can replace one or two ordinary Thunderer slots. Use only what your actual alliance and recruitment panel offers; it is not required for this guide or for VCO.

When the screen fails
Add or upgrade one escort unit, keep the Slayer counterattack protected, and restore losses before another assault. Theme does not require every unit to be a fragile attacker.
When the budget fails

Retain Warriors/Longbeards, buy elite replacements gradually and reduce the number of expensive airships before abandoning the whole campaign plan. A functioning field army now beats a perfect roster twenty turns later.

Three Ironbreakers anchor the ground company; the Brimstone gyro flight and two recruited barges establish the air identity.
Keep the signature units
Keep the Pirates and signature Hewer.
One force strikes, one holds
A supporting force holds captured provinces while Malakai strikes.

notes: Thematic recommendation
The composition is a thematic recommendation, not a lore-mandated roster or a tested optimum for Smart Autoresolve. Losing some efficiency is an intentional trade for a recognisable expedition.
Unique characters stay with Malakai
Malakai, Gotrek and Felix stay together in his field army. The supporting-army version uses ordinary Dwarf characters; it does not duplicate unique companions or inherit all his personal bonuses.
Escort, counterattack and experiment
Treat shielded infantry as the escort, Slayers as the counterattack and the machines as the experiment. Do not order every unit into a single continuous melee line.
The Spirit is not a recruited slot
The Spirit of Grungni is additional summoned support. It is not one of the twenty recruited slots, and its exact treatment by Smart Autoresolve remains unverified.
Monster-heavy substitution
Against a monster-heavy opponent, retain regular Slayers or substitute Giant Slayers for the two Doomseekers. That is a change of job, not an automatic upgrade ladder.
Optional allied-relief flavour

For an optional allied-relief flavour, an outpost-provided Empire infantry or gunpowder detachment can replace one or two ordinary Thunderer slots. Use only what your actual alliance and recruitment panel offers; it is not required for this guide or for VCO.
Unavailable unit or hero
Use another useful existing troop in that slot until recruitment, capacity and budget allow the intended unit. A template is a destination, not a reason to stop an otherwise viable war.
No old paid-DLC dependency
The core templates use the base Dwarf roster and Malakai’s WH3 content. They do not require Rangers, Bolt Throwers or Runelords from paid WH1 content.
Optional flavour: allied Empire detachment

A useful allied Empire unit can replace a comparable role after actual allied recruitment is available. Treat it as a small coalition detachment, not a requirement to buy another roster or weaken the army.
When the screen fails
Add or upgrade one escort unit, keep the Slayer counterattack protected, and restore losses before another assault. Theme does not require every unit to be a fragile attacker.
When the budget fails

Retain Warriors/Longbeards, buy elite replacements gradually and reduce the number of expensive airships before abandoning the whole campaign plan. A functioning field army now beats a perfect roster twenty turns later.
plan: Upgrade the escort and shock pair
Improve the escort to Ironbreakers; turn the shock pair into Doomseekers when available.
Barges replace the test flight
Two recruited Thunderbarges replace the earlier test-flight pair.
Keep the identity units
Keep the Hewer and Pirates as part of the army’s identity.

notes: Raise only what the border needs
Raise only what the actual border needs. Upgrade Warriors to Longbeards before turning an inexpensive guard into a full premium army.
A budget tool, not a guarantee
A threatened major front may need a real 20-stack. This template is a budget tool, not a guarantee that half an army holds any siege.
Keep budget for emergencies
Keep spare budget for emergency recruitment. Do not count a distant Malakai army as immediate home defence.
Companions stay with Malakai
Its conventional roster is intentional: the famous companions and experimental machines belong with Malakai, not in every minor settlement defence.
